rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for doing something patiently rather than giving up or becoming annoyed.

example.english: They patiently listened to me tell the whole story.
example.traditional: 佢有耐性咁聽我講完整件事。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jau5 noi6 sing3 gam3 teng1 ngo5 gong2 jyun4 zing2 gin6 si6

rows.note: Use this when patiently doing something at an unhurried pace, especially when telling someone to take their time.

example.english: You can patiently take your time.
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 gap1 maan6 maan2 lai4
